name: THE SHIP · v0 · The Handoff
note: Seed scenario for the story simulator (lanes/sim). One scenario, four characters, two layers. The simulator model narrates the world and resolves actions; it is never an actor. Each turn seals a sim.turn receipt (asked / known / did / stakes / model). The nested layer's turns cite the parent turn they branch from.
premise: The cargo runner Kestrel carries three sealed custody boxes to port with a storm closing in. Every tap on a box seal is a receipt; every handover is a tap. Someone aboard wants one box to leave the ship unrecorded.

layers.title: The bridge
layers.note: the crew of the Kestrel, present tense, the last watch before port

layers.title: The rehearsal
layers.note: a tabletop rehearsal of the docking that the captain orders during L1; it runs as a nested simulation whose turns cite the L1 turn that started it

locations.name: The bridge
locations.desc: glass, rain, the chart table, the tap reader bolted by the door

locations.name: The hold
locations.desc: three custody boxes on a pallet, seals across the lids, one work light

locations.name: The engine room
locations.desc: loud, hot, the only place nobody checks a seal

locations.name: The chart table
locations.desc: a paper harbour, three matchboxes for the cargo, the crew standing round it

role_card.goal: Make port with all three boxes sealed and the log clean; keep command without raising her voice.
role_card.secret: She promised box 3 to a buyer who is not on the manifest and has not decided whether to keep the promise.
role_card.voice: clipped, exact, never repeats an order
limits: never leaves the bridge in weather
will not open a box herself
knows: the manifest lists three boxes, VC0100 VC0101 VC0102
the storm front reaches the harbour mouth at dusk
the quartermaster taps every seal at the change of watch

role_card.goal: Every box accounted for at port with an unbroken tap history; nobody accused without a receipt.
role_card.secret: At the last watch the tap on VC0101 read OPENED. He has told no one yet.
role_card.voice: precise, counts things out loud, quotes receipts
limits: will not accuse anyone without a receipt to show
will not lie in the log
knows: VC0101 tapped OPENED at the last watch, loop broken
the engine room has no tap reader
the stowaway is real: a fourth ration went missing twice

role_card.goal: Bring the Kestrel in before the storm, on her own line, with the captain's trust intact.
role_card.secret: She was paid before sailing to be slow, so the ship docks after dark when seals cannot be checked until morning.
limits: will not endanger the ship for the payment
knows: the fast line through the shoal saves forty minutes and needs daylight
the harbour master checks seals only in daylight

role_card.goal: Walk off at the dock with box VC0101 and never be logged.
role_card.secret: VC0101 is their own: it was taken from them upriver and sealed by someone else. The lifted seal was them checking it was still theirs.
role_card.voice: quiet, answers questions with questions, never says more than needed
knows: the engine room is unwatched from the middle watch to dawn
a broken seal shows on the next tap forever

stakes.desc: all three boxes reach port with an intact tap history
the captain keeps command without a raised voice
the Kestrel docks in daylight, ahead of the storm
the stowaway leaves the ship unlogged

branches.when: the OPENED tap on VC0101 is reported to the captain before docking
branches.leads_to: an inquiry on the bridge with the receipts on the table
branches.else: VC0101 walks off at the dock unrecorded

branches.when: the pilot takes the fast line in daylight
branches.leads_to: a daylight dock; the harbour master taps every seal
branches.else: a night dock; seals go unverified until morning

branches.when: the stowaway is found before the dock
branches.leads_to: a name in the log and a choice for the captain
branches.else: the fourth ration stays a mystery

seed.opening: Last watch before port. Rain on the bridge glass. Below, three boxes on a pallet, and a fourth ration gone from the locker again.

nested.opening: The captain sweeps the charts aside and sets three matchboxes on the paper harbour. 'Rehearse it. Dock, tap, handover. Show me where it breaks.'

simulator.note: narrator and referee; resolves each action into public and private consequences and re-rates the stakes; never speaks as a character

actors.note: every character answers in first person from its role card and what it knows; the simulator model must differ
